content.text: § 22 meets the preferred position in full, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: § 22 is the only audit/verification right binding us (§ 23 is a heading only, with no operative Vendor-side rights). It matches the preferred position on every material term: frequency capped at once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express prohibition on direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information. § 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the report, shortfall payment resolves the issue). No redline required.
